summary.profile_finding: perf record on NEQ016_size7 (20s bounded window, process did not terminate pre-fix) showed ~76% of all samples inside ProofForest::explain and its two NCA-search helpers: aux_find 38%, explain 19%, nearest_common_ancestor 13%, explain_along_path 6%. summary.bug_1_tree_depth: Lemma 13's amortized O(log n) reversal bound requires every Union to reverse the smaller side's path. reoriented-proof-forest's direct-equation caller already does this (chooses e/e' by live class_size_ before calling union_nodes). coalesce_into_structural_class's fallback branch (member vs canonical, chosen by lookup-table arrival order) and materialize (always reverses the alias source's path) had no size discipline at all, and live class_size_ stops being an accurate proxy for real tree size once fast-path aliasing exists (an aliased member inflates its live class without adding real tree depth). Fixed by adding ProofForest's own size_ tracking and making union_nodes itself swap which physical node plays e vs e' when the caller's choice disagrees with tracked size -- sound regardless of caller intent, since a tree edge's label proves its two endpoints equal however it is attached. Verified via direct instrumentation: max real tree depth stayed at 46 after 200,000 union_nodes calls post-fix, versus growing unboundedly before.
summary.bug_2_memoization: Fixing bug 1 alone did not fix NEQ016_size7 (still did not finish in 30s). Further instrumentation showed seed_and_resolve (explain's alias-chain walker) called over 1 billion times in 15 seconds against only ~5,000 top-level Explain calls in that window; alias-chain hop count itself stayed flat (max 1 hop, confirming bug 1's fix was working and this was a separate issue). The auxiliary union-find already deduplicates repeat tree-edge congruence obligations reached via explain_along_path's NCA walk (the mechanism Section 5.2's own complexity argument depends on), but nothing deduplicated repeat alias-bridge obligations reached via seed_and_resolve -- a coalesced node's bridge obligations were pushed once per referencing obligation, not once per Explain call, and structural-class coalescing routinely produces a few popular hub canonical nodes referenced many times within one call. Fixed with the same generation-stamped mark pattern already used for aux_generation_/ancestor_generation_ in this file (seed_marks_/seed_generation_): a node's bridge obligations are now pushed at most once per top-level Explain call.
summary.result: NEQ016_size7 standalone: 180s+ (not finishing) -> 3.67s, in line with default (3.11s) and reoriented-proof-forest (3.05s). 334-file sweep (10s timeout): solved 232->248 (PAR2 9.329->8.643); reoriented-proof-forest in the same post-fix run was 254/8.279, so the gap closed from 27 files behind to 6 files behind, and file-level divergence dropped from 43/334 to 20/334.
